name: Let's Make a Deal
overview: Audience members dress up in outlandish costumes to get host Wayne Brady's attention in an attempt to make deals for trips, prizes, cars or cash, while trying to avoid the dreaded Zonks.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: The third season raises the bar with an array of new and exciting games, adding more high-value bargaining into the mix of the show. Host Wayne Brady will tempt contestants to increase the stakes during each of their trades and give audience members a chance to win big-ticket trips to exotic destinations such as Argentina, Australia and a luxurious railway trip across Canada. Brady's comedy and improvisational act will include a new sidekick, keyboardist extraordinaire Cat Gray.

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: The seventh season kicks off with “Mega Deal Week,” during which the Big Deal winner at the end of each show will be able to compete for every merchandise prize seen on that day’s episode. Over the course of the week, Traders will compete for over a half million dollars’ worth of prizes, the largest total in the show’s history. As a special bonus in one of the episodes, the show will offer one lucky audience member the chance to win a $2,000 Quickie Deal as a “thank you” to fans for making them the number one game show on Twitter.

seasons.name: Season 8
seasons.overview: The game show kicks off its eighth season with the return of “Mega Deal Week,” which offers Traders who win the day’s signature Big Deal an opportunity to mega-size their winnings and walk away with every merchandise prize featured that day. Throughout premiere week, Traders compete for a total of $1.1 million in cash and prizes. The excitement continues when Let's Make a Deal reaches its 1,400th episode later this season and surpasses the $50-million mark in prize giveaways since the show’s premiere in 2009 on the Network.

seasons.name: Season 9
seasons.overview: The show launches its ninth season with a sleek, remodeled set and “Premiere Week Prize-a-Palooza,” offering Traders the opportunity to compete for more than $1.1 million in cash and prizes. Adding to the excitement, for the first time at the beginning of each show, host Wayne Brady will reveal a sneak peek at some of the biggest prizes being offered that day, from luxury cars to a trio of trips around the world. Let's Make a Deal keeps the party going throughout the entire season with special themed episodes, including a “Wayne’s Favorite Folks” week, filling the audience with special groups Wayne has chosen to honor, from teachers to grandparents; a Prom episode with a theme selected by fans through social media; and a salute to the game show’s landmark 1,500th episode.

seasons.name: Season 10
seasons.overview: The 10th anniversary season returns with fan-favorite “Zonk Redemption” which gets super-sized from one episode to a week-long event as a thank you to the series’ devoted audience. The exciting week of episodes offers formerly “zonked” traders from the show’s past nine seasons the opportunity to redeem themselves. Each of these former contestants will be in the audience for the entire week and have the chance to leave a big winner or get zonked yet again.

seasons.name: Season 11
seasons.overview: Premiere week feature an entire week of Triptastic Deals! Each day, three lucky contestants will have the opportunity to win a trio of trips that will take them all over the world, with one taking home a Triptastic Deal of a lifetime at the end of every episode!
